name: Claim all mail
goal: Collect every reward waiting in the in-game mail — event rewards, compensation and gifts arrive there, and letters expire.
doneWhen: The mail list shows no reward icons waiting, and tapping Claim All again brings no Item Obtained box.

steps.find: A "Rate Me" popup over the game, with Maybe Later on the left and Confirm on the right
The pod-in-a-ring icon at the right-hand end of the row of icons in the top-right corner of the game screen
steps.expect: The main menu slides in on the right: a grid of tiles, and a close X where the icon was

steps.find: The envelope icon on the thin vertical rail at the right edge of the main menu, below the gear
steps.expect: The Mail list opens, titled "Mail" with a count out of 200

steps.find: The "Claim All" button at the bottom of the mail list. NOT "Delete Read", which sits just to its left
steps.expect: An "Item Obtained" box shows what was collected, or nothing changes if there was nothing to claim

steps.find: An "Item Obtained" box in the middle of the screen
steps.expect: The box closes and the mail list is back

steps.find: The back arrow at the top-left of the mail screen
The round close X in the top-right corner of the main menu
steps.expect: The menu closes and the game screen is back

signed: Claude, 2026-10-25 — draft, not yet run or seen on the player's phone
